notes: 'even' at t021 is correctly added: the clause's one object marker stands on כָּל־אֲגַפָּיו, which the ASV renders bare, and rule 16 limits an appositional 'even' to the phrase the marker actually stands on — the same shape as the rule's own EZK 4:5 example.
The two supplied 'the's are counted by the word each stands before (rule 29): neither יַרְכְּתֵי nor צָפוֹן carries an article morpheme, so each takes the 'the' opening its own phrase.
אִתָּךְ is the comitative preposition H854, not the object-marker homograph, and no copula is written for the verbless clause.
